name: Jacksonville Jaguars
notes: Revenue, operating income, player expenses and valuation are Forbes estimates (2026 list / profile, 2025 season). Capacity 67,862 is Forbes' pre-renovation figure; the club states 2026 capacity is 42,465 and the renovated stadium will seat more than 63,000. The city/team split of the $1.4bn renovation is not stated on a page I could read (The Athletic and ESPN blocked). Founding date is the NFL award to J. Wayne Weaver (franchise awarded 30 Nov 1993). No legal entity, kit supplier, honours, attendance or social counts found. No institutional investor found.
ownership_summary: Owned by Shad (Shahid) Khan, who agreed to buy the club from founder Wayne Weaver on 29 November 2011 and took ownership in January 2012. No minority or institutional investor is stated on a citable page.
